entry.name: icon
entry.label: Icon shown on the panel button: an icon name or a file path. Empty uses Protea's own icon.

entry.name: headerFooterDarkBackground
entry.label: Whether to draw dark backgrounds (black at 25% opacity) behind the header and footer: the search bar at the top and the utility bar at the bottom.

entry.name: searchBarRoundCorners
entry.label: Whether the search bar has fully rounded ends instead of the theme's corners. Round fills it with the text colour at 10%, with no outline at rest, the hover colour (the accent) at 50% as its outline on hover, and the focus colour while it has focus.

entry.name: columns
entry.label: Number of app grid columns the popup is sized for.

entry.name: rows
entry.label: Number of app grid rows the popup is sized for.

entry.name: gridSize
entry.label: Size of the app grid: "compact" (36px icons in 108px tiles), "small" (40px in 112px), "cozy" (44px in 116px), "medium" (48px in 120px) or "large" (56px in 128px).

entry.name: smallerTiles
entry.label: Whether to use tiles 8px smaller than the size's usual ones: 100px for compact, 104px for small, 108px for cozy, 112px for medium and 120px for large.

entry.name: hiddenApps
entry.label: Apps left out of the app grid, by desktop file ID (e.g. "org.kde.dolphin.desktop"). They still show up in search results.

entry.name: utilityButtons
entry.label: Buttons on the right of the utility bar: "settings" opens System Settings and "power" opens the power menu. Session actions (lock-screen, logout, save-session, switch-user, suspend, hibernate, reboot, shutdown) can also be listed to give them buttons of their own.

entry.name: powerMenuActions
entry.label: Session actions listed in the power menu: lock-screen, logout, save-session, switch-user, suspend, hibernate, reboot, shutdown. Actions the system doesn't support are hidden.
